# Backend audit checks

`tfcensus audit backend` runs 25 checks on the state buckets, lock tables and states its units use. Every finding carries the check ID as its `rule`, a severity and a reason. `--fail-on` takes the lowest severity that fails the run. Keys under `audit.policy` set the thresholds, and `audit.suppress` hides findings with a reason and an optional `expires` date ([configuration](/reference/config#audit)).

## State buckets

Run once per state bucket.

| Check | Severity | Passes when | Fix | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `S3-VER` | high | State bucket versioning is enabled | Enable versioning, so an overwritten or deleted state can be restored. |  |
| `S3-MFA` | low | State bucket has MFA delete | Informational: MFA delete needs the root user's MFA device and is rarely practical. |  |
| `S3-ENC` | medium | State bucket encrypts with a customer-managed KMS key | Set default encryption to SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key, so key policy controls who can decrypt state. |  |
| `S3-KMSPOL` | high | State key policy doesn't let every principal decrypt | Remove kms:Decrypt for Principal "\*", or restrict it with aws:PrincipalAccount or aws:PrincipalOrgID. |  |
| `S3-PAB` | high | Bucket and account public access block are all on | Turn on all four public access block settings on the bucket and the account. |  |
| `S3-TLS` | high | State bucket policy denies requests without TLS | Add a Deny for Principal "\*", Action s3:\*, the bucket and bucket/\* resources, with Bool aws:SecureTransport false as the only condition. |  |
| `S3-OWN` | medium | Object ownership is BucketOwnerEnforced | Set object ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced, which turns ACLs off. |  |
| `S3-REPL` | medium | State is replicated to another region | Configure cross-region replication to a versioned, KMS-encrypted bucket. |  |
| `S3-LC` | medium | Noncurrent state versions expire after a bounded time | Add a lifecycle rule with NoncurrentVersionExpiration of at least the policy's noncurrent_days. | [`audit.policy.noncurrent_days`](/reference/config#audit-policy-noncurrent-days) |
| `S3-LOG` | low | State access is logged | Turn on server access logging or CloudTrail S3 data events for the bucket. |  |
| `S3-LEGACY` | low | No legacy RootAccess statement | Remove the RootAccess statement that terragrunt before 1.2 added; the account root has access through IAM. |  |

## Locks

Run once per unit backend and lock table.

| Check | Severity | Passes when | Fix | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LK-MODE` | low | Unit locks with S3 lock files | Set use_lockfile = true: dynamodb_table is deprecated since Terraform 1.11. Keep both during the migration. |  |
| `LK-BOTH` | info | Unit uses one lock mechanism | Both lock files and DynamoDB are configured, which is fine while migrating. Remove dynamodb_table afterwards. |  |
| `LK-PITR` | medium | Lock table has point-in-time recovery and KMS encryption | Turn on point-in-time recovery and encrypt the table with a KMS key. |  |
| `LK-STALE` | high | No stale locks | Check that no run holds the lock, then release it with terraform force-unlock. | [`audit.policy.stale_lock_hours`](/reference/config#audit-policy-stale-lock-hours) |
| `LK-MD5` | low | No orphaned digest items | Delete the -md5 item: its state object no longer exists. |  |

## Fleet and states

Run over the states and the units that point at them.

| Check | Severity | Passes when | Fix | Set by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FL-ORPHAN` | medium | Every state key belongs to a unit | Delete or archive the state, or add the unit that owns it to the scanned repos. |  |
| `FL-ABSENT` | low | Every unit's state exists | Apply the unit, or fix its backend key. |  |
| `FL-EMPTY` | low | State manages resources | Destroy the unit's code and state, or check that the key is right. |  |
| `FL-LINEAGE` | high | Each lineage lives under one key | One of the states is a copy. Keep the one the unit applies to and archive the other. |  |
| `FL-DOUBLE` | high | Each resource is managed by one state | Remove the resource from all but one state with terraform state rm, or a removed block. |  |
| `FL-TFVER` | medium | State was written by a supported version | Upgrade the unit's terraform or tofu to at least the policy's min_terraform_version. | [`audit.policy.min_terraform_version`](/reference/config#audit-policy-min-terraform-version) |
| `FL-PROV` | low | Provider versions meet the policy | Upgrade the provider in .terraform.lock.hcl with terraform init -upgrade. | [`audit.policy.min_provider_versions`](/reference/config#audit-policy-min-provider-versions) |
| `FL-SIZE` | low | State is small enough for fast plans | Split the unit. | [`audit.policy.max_state_mb`](/reference/config#audit-policy-max-state-mb) |
| `FL-SECRET` | info | No secrets stored in plain state | Use write-only arguments or ephemeral resources, or keep the secret in a secrets manager. |  |

## Suppress a finding

```yaml
audit:
  suppress:
    - check: S3-MFA
      reason: MFA delete needs the root user's device
    - check: LK-*
      bucket: acme-legacy-tfstate
      reason: the legacy fleet moves to lock files in Q1
      expires: "2027-03-31"
```
